blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Elections (Comelec) may no longer be able to hold the Nov. 2 barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) elections if the Supreme Court (SC) issues a temporary restraining order (TRO) order on the postponement of the electoral exercise, Comelec Chairperson George Garcia said Monday. Garcia made the remark during the Senate finance committee hearing of the Comelec’s 2027 budget. Following a petition filed before the SC seeking to declare Republic Act 12326 unconstitutional and to stop the postponement of the elections, Senate President Pro Tempore Vicente Sotto III asked Comelec how it would respond if a […]...
